name: Egnyte
description: Egnyte is a cloud content security and collaboration platform for organizations. Teams use it to store and share files, manage access and governance, automate document workflows, search business content, and protect regulated information.
agentUseSummary: Connect an Egnyte domain once, then let agents use every selected active operation in Egnyte's official Public API under Safe or Dangerous policy.

capabilities.label: Read Egnyte
capabilities.description: Use all 71 active documented retrieval operations for content, search, permissions, sharing, workflows, reporting, users, AI, and governance metadata.

capabilities.label: Manage content and workflows
capabilities.description: Use all 46 selected active non-admin content, sharing, signing, AI, workflow, and collaboration mutations.

capabilities.label: Administer Egnyte
capabilities.description: Use all 51 selected active user, group, permission, metadata, reporting, integration, and webhook mutations when the connected account permits it.

allowed.label: Read Egnyte

approvalRequired.label: Manage Egnyte content
approvalRequired.description: Run one exact active documented content or collaboration mutation; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalRequired.label: Administer Egnyte

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All 71 bounded Egnyte reads run directly; every content, sharing, workflow, destructive, or administrative mutation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All 168 selected and Egnyte-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; connection ownership, the fixed customer domain, exact routes, bounds, audits, redaction, provider limits, and account authority still apply.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's public Egnyte API key, production approval, exact callback, and live customer-domain authorization are not configured on Railway.
providerSetup.nextAction: Register Relay Console as a public Egnyte integration, configure https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/egnyte/callback, complete Egnyte's production review, store EGNYTE_CLIENT_ID on Railway, then verify public OAuth, domain binding, identity, reads, Safe approval, Dangerous mutations, local disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Egnyte's official OpenAPI 3.0.3 specification identifies 168 active operations after excluding four explicitly deprecated operations: 71 GET retrievals and 97 mutations across content, collaboration, AI, reporting, governance, integrations, and administration.
Egnyte documents public OAuth for broadly distributed integrations, a test-account restriction before production approval, API access without an additional fee, and per-token and OAuth rate limits.
Egnyte's official SDK documents the customer-domain /puboauth/token authorization endpoint, bearer tokens returned to the registered redirect URI, and /pubapi/v1/userinfo identity validation.
Egnyte's developer terms require API application approval and permit distribution of approved integrations subject to provider restrictions and rate limits.
